mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz.wcs_inbound_order_h ( task_id, pallet_id, cmd_status, recv_message_id, last_message_id, recv_count, received_at, qty_updated_at, mapped_at, completed_at, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{palletId}, #{cmdStatus}, #{recvMessageId}, #{lastMessageId}, #{recvCount}, #{receivedAt}, #{qtyUpdatedAt}, #{mappedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{cancelledAt}, #{cancelReason}, COALESCE(#{createdBy}, 'SYSTEM'), COALESCE(#{updatedBy}, 'SYSTEM') )
mapper.update: UPDATE biz.wcs_inbound_order_h SET last_message_id = #{lastMessageId}, recv_count = recv_count + 1, qty_updated_at = #{qtyUpdatedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND pallet_id = #{palletId}

UPDATE biz.wcs_inbound_order_h SET cmd_status = #{cmdStatus}, mapped_at = COALESCE(#{mappedAt}, mapped_at), completed_at = COALESCE(#{completedAt}, completed_at), cancelled_at = COALESCE(#{cancelledAt}, cancelled_at), cancel_reason = COALESCE(#{cancelReason}, cancel_reason), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND pallet_id = #{palletId}
